author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest trailer for Moylo! Moylo is a classical hand-drawn action game with melee combat and intense boss battles. Animated frame by frame in a classic rubber hose cartoon style in 1930s & 1940s, explore a world swallowed by the shadow of death, master combat, and overcome relentless enemies.
Wishlist on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4877950/Moylo/
title: Moylo - Official Classic Cartoony Game Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Meet Caster (VA: Chiwa Saito) in this latest Fate/Extra Record trailer for this upcoming RPG, and learn more about this sorceress with exceptional knowledge who excels at tactical combat. Caster is one of the Servants the protagonist can make a contract with. Fate/Extra Record will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Steam on January 28, 2027.

Based on Fate/Extra, which released on the PlayStation Portable in 2010, Fate/Extra Record revises and expands the narrative to add new layers and depth to one of the franchise’s core entries, while also modernizing the title’s audio-visual presentation and adding an all-new strategic battle system that combines turn-based battles with a unique deck-building system.
title: Fate/Extra Record - Official Caster Character Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Wanted: a reliable technician who follows the rules, handles sensitive information with discretion, and does not ask questions. Fix the phones. Don't look too closely. Check out the Don’t Pick Up announcement trailer for this upcoming psychological horror sim game set in a dystopian city under constant surveillance. Don't Pick Up will be available on PC. A demo will be available on September 24, 2026.
title: Don’t Pick Up - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Pao Pao, the upcoming cozy co-op restaurant sim with an adorable art style (that also includes farming, fishing, building, and more), is preparing to launch into Steam Early Access on October 26, and to celebrate, developer ArtDock released a new trailer. Wishlist it out on Steam – and check out the playable demo – if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3024130/PAO_PAO/
title: Pao Pao: Official Early Access Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival is available now on PC via Steam, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2. Watch The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival launch trailer for this retro-inspired beat 'em up game inspired by the All-Out War storyline from AMC's The Walking Dead. 

The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival pits Rick and his allies against the merciless Saviors and relentless hordes of the undead. Play as iconic survivors Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon, Michonne, or the vicious Negan as you battle foes living and dead across classic environments like the Sanctuary, Hilltop, Alexandria, and more.
title: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest Path of Exile 2 trailer for the action RPG to see what to expect from The Stonefist Cosmetic Bundle, which features an Armour Set, a Character Skin, Quarterstaff Skill Effects, a Charge Effect, and a Dodge Roll Effect to complete your transformation into a master of stone. 

Move mountains, shatter stone, and bend the earth itself to your will with The Stonefist Cosmetic Bundle. Tear rock from the ground and raise towering pillars of earth before bringing them crashing down upon your enemies.

Path of Exile 2 is out now in Early Access, with version 1.0 available on December 11, 2026. The Stonefist: Legends of Wraeclast Pack is out now.
title: Path of Exile 2 - Official The Stonefist: Legends of Wraeclast Pack Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Meet the fighters of Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero Super-Limit Breaking Neo in this latest trailer for the fighting game's DLC. The new trailer spotlights Dragon Ball characters like Goku (World Tournament), Chi-Chi, Tien (World Tournament), King Piccolo, Spike the Devil Man, and more. Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero Super-Limit Breaking Neo is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam. The Super Limit-Breaking Neo DLC, Mission 100, and Survival Mode for Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch are planned for 2027.
title: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero Super-Limit Breaking Neo - Dragon Ball Character Showcase Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a closer look at a Level 55 Blessed Beam Revenant build in this latest Titan Quest 2 trailer for the action RPG. Harness the power of Warfare and Spirit in this Revenant build centered around an empowered Deathward Beam. Stack up passive and conditional boosts, as well as active blessings to get as powerful of a beam as possible. Titan Quest 2 is available in PC Early Access.
title: Titan Quest 2 - Official Blessed Beam Revenant Build Breakdown Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a deep dive into the new Walkway Attraction feature coming to Jurassic World Evolution 3 in this latest trailer for the sim game. Give your park guests a whole new perspective with the all-new Walkway Attraction, which is included as part of the free Update 1.5. Update 1.5 of Jurassic World Evolution 3 will be available on September 29, 2026. Jurassic World Evolution 3 is out now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S.

In Jurassic World Evolution 3, build your own Jurassic World. Nurture generations of dinosaurs with the series debut of juveniles, create and manage sprawling prehistoric parks around the globe, and let your imagination roar with powerful new creative options.
title: Jurassic World Evolution 3 - Official Update 1.5 Highlights Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the latest Killing Floor 3 teaser trailer for a peek at the new main menu video and music coming soon to the Halloween update for the action shooter game. Killing Floor 3 is available now on PC (via Steam and Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S.
title: Killing Floor 3 - Official Halloween Horrors Teaser Trailer
